title: Billing automation payment plan payment request

PaymentMethods.description: Allowed payment methods to use for the payment plan.

Message.description: Message for customer in the payment request email.

Note.description: Internal note for the payment request.

ExpirationDateUtc.description: Expiration date (UTC time) of the payment request. Must be within 30 days of payment plan creation. ISO-8601 format.

SendEmail.description: Specifies whether a payment request email is sent to the customer.
